title: Create a reusable experiment framework
body:
Define a shared experiment contract for inputs, outputs, derived values, presets, and explanations.
Separate simulation logic from UI rendering.
Standardise how each lab exposes parameters, equations, and live results.
Add a registry so new experiments can be added without changing core routing.
Acceptance criteria: a new experiment can be added with minimal boilerplate and consistent page behaviour.

title: Build shared UI components
body:
Create reusable sliders, numeric inputs, toggles, buttons, and unit labels.
Add a formula panel and live value cards.
Add graphing hooks for time series and derived values.
Ensure components work across desktop and mobile.
Acceptance criteria: all experiments can use the same control and display components.

title: Add URL state and shareable presets
body:
Encode experiment settings in the URL.
Support predefined scenarios and randomised starting states.
Add reset, copy link, and preset selection controls.
Acceptance criteria: every experiment can be reopened with the same state from a link.

title: Improve accessibility and keyboard support
body:
Add labels, ARIA support, and focus states.
Support keyboard-only interaction for all controls.
Add reduced-motion handling where animation is used.
Add text summaries of key results for screen readers.
Acceptance criteria: core labs are usable without a mouse and are accessible to assistive tech.

title: Add automated calculation tests
body:
Create unit tests for equations and derived outputs.
Cover invalid inputs, edge cases, and rounding behaviour.
Add snapshot tests for key explanation panels if useful.
Acceptance criteria: core physics calculations are protected by test coverage.

title: Add refraction and Snell's law lab
body:
Build an interactive boundary between two media.
Allow refractive indices and incident angle to be changed.
Show refracted ray, normal line, and computed angles live.
Add total internal reflection behaviour when applicable.
Acceptance criteria: users can explore refraction and critical angle visually and numerically.

title: Add thin lens and image formation lab
body:
Support converging and diverging lenses.
Allow object distance, focal length, and object height to be changed.
Show image position, magnification, and orientation live.
Add principal ray visualisation and object/image labels.
Acceptance criteria: image formation follows the lens equation and updates in real time.

title: Add mirror lab
body:
Support plane, concave, and convex mirror modes.
Calculate image position and size from object position.
Show reflected rays and image type clearly.
Acceptance criteria: mirror behaviour is understandable and consistent across modes.

title: Add prism and dispersion lab
body:
Build a prism refraction model with wavelength-dependent refractive index.
Show spectral separation across visible wavelengths.
Add a white-light input mode and monochromatic mode.
Acceptance criteria: users can see dispersion as a function of wavelength.

title: Add interference and diffraction lab
body:
Implement double-slit and single-slit modes.
Allow wavelength, slit spacing, slit width, and screen distance to be adjusted.
Show fringe spacing and intensity distribution.
Acceptance criteria: users can connect parameters to interference and diffraction patterns.

title: Add Coulomb field visualiser
body:
Render electric field vectors around one or more point charges.
Allow charge magnitude and sign to be changed.
Show force direction and field strength numerically.
Acceptance criteria: users can explore field structure around charges.

title: Add potential and equipotential lab
body:
Visualise scalar potential on a grid or contour map.
Link potential values to field direction.
Support multiple charges and simple configurations.
Acceptance criteria: users can compare field and potential views.

title: Add Ohm's law circuit lab
body:
Build a simple circuit with adjustable voltage and resistance.
Show current, voltage drop, and power live.
Add series and parallel resistor modes.
Acceptance criteria: users can calculate and observe Ohm's law in a clear circuit view.

title: Add capacitor charging lab
body:
Model RC charging and discharging curves.
Show time constant and stored energy.
Allow resistance and capacitance to be adjusted.
Acceptance criteria: users can explore transient behaviour and time constants.

title: Add resistor network lab
body:
Support series and parallel resistor combinations.
Calculate equivalent resistance and branch currents.
Display the circuit diagram and simplified equivalent model.
Acceptance criteria: users can solve and visualise multi-resistor networks.

title: Add magnetic field visualiser
body:
Render fields around straight wires, loops, and solenoids.
Allow current direction and magnitude to be changed.
Show field direction and relative strength with clear vectors or lines.
Acceptance criteria: users can compare magnetic field patterns for different current geometries.

title: Add moving charge in magnetic field lab
body:
Model force on a charged particle in a uniform magnetic field.
Allow charge sign, velocity, and field strength to be changed.
Show curved trajectories and radius of motion.
Acceptance criteria: users can see how magnetic force changes particle motion.

title: Add motor effect lab
body:
Model force on a current-carrying wire in a magnetic field.
Allow field direction, current direction, and wire orientation to be changed.
Show force direction with vector overlays.
Acceptance criteria: users can predict and verify the direction of force.

title: Add electromagnetic induction lab
body:
Model changing magnetic flux and induced emf.
Support moving magnet, moving coil, and changing current scenarios.
Show flux, emf, and current direction live.
Acceptance criteria: users can connect flux change to induced voltage.

title: Add guided learning mode
body:
Create step-by-step prompts for each lab.
Add prediction prompts before values are changed.
Include hints and short explanations for key results.
Acceptance criteria: each lab supports both free exploration and guided learning.

title: Add worked examples
body:
Create a worked example section for each experiment.
Show the same equation path used by the simulator.
Keep examples concise and consistent.
Acceptance criteria: users can compare a manual calculation to the live model.

title: Add misconception notes
body:
Document common errors and misunderstandings for each topic.
Link misconceptions to the relevant control or graph.
Add short corrective explanations.
Acceptance criteria: each lab includes at least one teaching note on common pitfalls.

title: Add curriculum navigation
body:
Group labs by topic and difficulty.
Add next experiment and related links.
Create an overview page for the full physics series.
Acceptance criteria: users can move through the platform as a sequence of lessons.

title: Define experiment metadata schema
body:
Add fields for title, topic, subtopic, learning goals, equations, parameters, and presets.
Store metadata in a format that can drive pages and listings.
Include accessibility and prerequisite notes.
Acceptance criteria: every lab can be described with the same structured schema.

title: Add documentation and authoring guide
body:
Document how to create a new experiment.
Explain naming conventions, file structure, and contribution rules.
Add guidance for equations, units, and content tone.
Acceptance criteria: a new contributor can add a lab without guessing conventions.

title: Add analytics and usage tracking
body:
Track which labs are opened, used, and shared.
Measure which controls are most interacted with.
Use the data to prioritise future experiments.
Acceptance criteria: usage data can inform roadmap decisions.

title: Add quality assurance checklist
body:
Verify maths, layout, accessibility, and responsive behaviour.
Test each new lab against the same release checklist.
Record known limitations and future improvements.
Acceptance criteria: every release follows the same review process.
